name: WalkPlane_Within
comment:
Sector_ContainsPoint(sector, point, checkActive). With checkActive, an inactive sector (+0x28 or +0x2c zero) contains nothing. 1) distance from the plane (normal at +0x60..+0x68, vertex[1]): a distance <= 1e-5 counts as 0, then |d| <= height (+0x30; 0.005 for walk sectors, or when the file says 0). 2) each edge prev->cur on the two axes +0x7c / +0x80: v = (p[a]-prev[a])*(cur[b]-prev[b]) - (p[b]-prev[b])*(cur[a]-prev[a]) + 1e-5, |v| <= 1e-5 -> 0, v < 0 = outside. So a point up to 2e-5 (cross-product units, i.e. 2e-5 / edge length) outside an edge is inside.
Ported to C (build/overrides_asm_o2.c): differential test, 0 differences (docs/notes/asm_o2.md). Original name WalkPlane_Within (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): same body (optional active / visible check, the plane distance test against the first vertex, then the edge tests)); was Sector_ContainsPoint.
